description: This Java source file defines a class HibernateSessionFactoryBean that extends Spring's LocalSessionFactoryBean. It integrates Hibernate ORM session factory setup with OpenMRS module system, managing mappings, packages, configuration properties, and interceptors, including module-specific configurations.

classes.name: HibernateSessionFactoryBean
classes.description: A Hibernate SessionFactory Bean that integrates Hibernate ORM with OpenMRS modules, managing mappings, configurations, interceptors, and integrating with Hibernate's SPI for module-based extensions.

methods.name: setMappingResources
methods.description: Sets the mapping resources, adding to existing list, and passes to superclass.

methods.name: setPackagesToScan
methods.description: Adds packages to scan for entity classes, accumulating across calls.

methods.name: getModuleMappingResources
methods.description: Aggregates mapping resources from all registered OpenMRS modules.

methods.name: getModulePackagesWithMappedClasses
methods.description: Retrieves packages with mapped classes from all started modules.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Initializes the session factory; loads properties, configures interceptors, and sets module mappings and packages.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources when session factory is destroyed.

methods.description: Implements Hibernate's Integrator interface to capture Metadata for custom integration.
